author: blu
body: Every function here that touches a register declares [Device.Mmio]. That is not decoration: the row is what makes the access visible to the effect system, to the capability manifest, and to the boot grant. A driver that reads or writes hardware while typed pure is a driver the machine cannot see, and until 2026-07-13 all nine board chapters were exactly that -- not because they lied, but because the `Boards` quire sat on the type checker's effect-exemption list and nobody checked them at all.
